title: Data and analysis for: An Open-Source 3D-Printed Vacuum Manifold for Automated DNA Isolation in the Opentrons Flex and OT-2
description: Raw plasmid yield data and Jupyter notebooks reproducing the yield comparison in the HardwareX manuscript. Includes a controlled comparison (one culture of plasmid C4J split across 3 manual preps and 3 runs of 24 preps on the manifold) and routine-use preps of plasmids prepared by both methods. Code is MIT licensed; data are CC BY 4.0. Hardware design files are in the companion record (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21674774).
